messages.subject: Nearly perfect replication of RMA estimates (in affyPLM)
parts:
Hi,

in a previous thread it was asked how well aroma.affymetrix could
reproduce the original RMA method. I forgot that Mark Robinson (WEHI)
had written a redundancy test that does exactly that for
HG-U133_Plus_2. Please find the test script and some graphs showing
the nearly perfect replication of RMA chip-effect estimates by affyPLM
at:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/redundancy-tests

Cheers

Henrik
